sources.entry: Ottex - AI dictation tool that formats text for the app or site you are using.

summary.name: Ottex
summary.one_liner: Ottex is a Mac voice-to-text dictation app that types into any app and takes AI meeting notes, with local or bring-your-own-key options.
use_cases: dictate emails and messages in any macOS app
run transcription fully on-device with local models
fix filler words and spoken corrections while typing
insert saved links or phrases by voice
summary.what_it_does: Ottex is a macOS dictation tool that types speech into the app or website you are using, with writing profiles that format output per app (for example, a professional email style). It supports a custom dictionary of names and technical terms used as spelling hints, and voice triggers that expand a spoken phrase into text such as a calendar link. It can record and transcribe meetings, producing notes and, per its FAQ, follow-up drafts and CRM or ticket updates. Dictation covers over 100 languages with automatic detection. Processing can be local (Whisper, Parakeet, Qwen-ASR, Voxtral listed), through the user's own API keys to supported providers, or through Ottex-managed AI on paid plans.
notable: Local models (Whisper, Parakeet, Qwen-ASR, Voxtral) so audio can stay on device
Writing profiles and custom dictionary that adapt output to the app you're using
Voice triggers that insert saved text or links
Team tier with SSO/SAML, admin controls, and a self-hosted/private backend option
caveats: Managed AI for dictation and meetings requires the paid Zero Setup plan at $14/month; team plan is $26/user/month
Bring-your-own-key option means the user manages provider accounts and usage
Page lists macOS as the platform; no other platforms are named
